reasons.plausibility: The proposed temperature-dependent ordering and partial-dislocation mechanism in this eutectic HEA aligns with known phase-transformation and stacking-fault phenomena, though the L12 ordering step may need more specific prior evidence.
reasons.testability: TEM/TKD studies of dislocation configurations and crack initiation sites before and after the specified thermal aging treatments provide a concrete and decisive means to test the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a structured approach to pinpoint the microstructural causes of embrittlement and recovery, guiding both fundamental understanding and potential design improvements.
